## The goal

What a person, or the bot working for them, is trying to get done, and what stops them today.

## The change you propose

What would be different afterwards: a new command, a new field, a new rule, a changed message. Show the command line and the JSON you would expect where you can.

## Other ways you considered

Anything else that would meet the goal, and why you prefer the change above.

## Who else it affects

Whether existing commands, stored data or other repositories would have to change. A change that breaks existing behavior needs a version bump, so say so if you think this is one.
